title: Zero Day (2025)
description: A political conspiracy thriller about a nuclear attack warning and a former US President who leads a secret commission to find the perpetrators.

title: The Batman (2022)
description: In his second year of fighting crime, Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.

title: Interstellar (2014)
description: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.

title: Monster
description: The young Dr. Tenma lives in Germany and is engaged to the daughter of the hospital director. After he operates on a boy, he loses his job and fiancée. When the doctors who fired him are poisoned, he is the prime suspect.
